v2-runtime-execution-gap.scope: V2 durable admission admits but never dispatches provider work, and the V1-shaped projection is empty (flag default off; custom always V2). VERIFIED OBSERVABLE FACTS from the real V2 variant run in /tmp/e4-v2-round: (1) the `session_input` row lands with admitted_seq=3 and promoted_seq=NULL, so the row was never promoted; (2) the deterministic provider recorded zero `/chat/completions` calls (its 3 recorded requests are all harness `/e4/*` endpoints); (3) `message` and `part` tables are empty, so no provider turn ever wrote projected output; (4) the backend emitted no drain-error line and no `booting location services` line. RETRACTED HYPOTHESIS (2026-09-20): an earlier note claimed `SessionPrompt.admitCanonical` resolved `SessionV2.Service` to `SessionV2.defaultLayer`'s noop execution. Reading `LayerNode.buildLayer` (packages/core/src/effect/layer-node.ts:70-105: `Layer.provide(impl, deps)`) plus `SessionPrompt.node`'s dependency list (packages/aigcfroge/src/session/prompt.ts:1931-1958, which has no SessionV2 node and whose type-level Missing-dependencies check compiles) shows no noop provide sits on that path; the handler's `SessionV2.Service` is satisfied by `v2RuntimeWithTaskDriver` -> `v2RuntimeLayer` -> real `SessionExecutionLocal`. The layer-assembly explanation is therefore NOT supported and no layer edit was made. The gap remains a live, reproducible product defect.
v2-runtime-execution-gap.unlock: Needs one decisive instrumented run on a host where the E4 V2 variant can be executed repeatedly (this FUSE-mounted host cannot): log or observe the wake->drain hop itself — coordinator `start` invocation, `SessionExecutionLocal` drain entry, and `SessionRunner.run`'s early-return branch — rather than inferring it from layer assembly. Do NOT change layer wiring on the retracted hypothesis. The existing pin (e2e/real/v2-admission-gap.spec.ts) stays green-means-gap-present until that instrumentation identifies the real breakpoint.

entries.test: the non-native picker path validates the selection before forwarding it
entries.unlock: CLOSED at the funnel, with an honest boundary. `useDirectoryPicker` now validates every picked directory through `validateDirectorySelection` before `input.onSelect`, on BOTH branches (native and server dialog), so no unreadable path reaches `projects.open()` from any add-project call site — all of them go through this one funnel. Evidence: `directory-picker.test.ts` 5 passed (2 new funnel contracts, 2 existing native-path contracts, 1 kind contract); app typecheck exit 0; lint-changed 190 files exit 0; prettier clean; `git diff --check` clean. `throwOnError: true` is set on both clients in server-sdk.tsx (:268 server-level, :326 dir-level), so a 404 from `file.list` rejects rather than resolving — the validation is not a false green. BROWSER NEGATIVE IS NOT EXPRESSIBLE BY DESIGN, measured not assumed: the V2 dialog disables its confirm button while the root is unlistable (dialog-select-directory-v2.tsx:142,153,357), and the legacy web picker swallows `file.list` failure into an empty list (directory-picker-domain.ts:384), so an unreadable directory never becomes a selectable row. The funnel validation is therefore defense-in-depth at the trust boundary (including the desktop native OS dialog, which can return any path), not a fix for a UI-reachable path. No browser spec was invented to make this look stronger than it is.
